purpose: Teach: ヌード/ピュア/パンドラ/ノア/聖母/ジミー/スーザン/アンディ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが美術館のヌード絵画展に行かれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going to see a nude painting exhibition at the art museum.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Slight knowing smile in the voice without judgment. Open and natural, like sharing something she finds endearingly typical of him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「ピュアな気持ちで頑張れ」って言われたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me to 'do your best with a pure heart.'
lines.style: Earnest, slightly confused but trusting. Small wonder in his voice—he's reporting something he doesn't quite understand but senses matters. No irony.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがギリシャ神話のパンドラの絵本を読んで下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is reading you a picture book about Pandora from Greek mythology.
lines.style: Warm observation. Gently approving tone. Slight pause before 'Pandora,' like she's noticing the connection he's making. Tender without calling attention to it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとノアの方舟の絵本観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a picture book about Noah's Ark together.
lines.style: Bright, direct report. The pride of having done something with Dad. Quick pace, no hesitation. Simple joy without embellishment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがミケランジェロの聖母像の画集を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is looking at an art book of Michelangelo's Madonna.
lines.style: Warm, observant. She's noticed the thread—the sacred, the tender figures. Delivered with quiet insight, like she sees what Ryosuke is slowly understanding.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとジミー・ファロンの動画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a Jimmy Fallon video together.
lines.style: Open, uncomplicated delivery. He's found another thing to share with Dad. Same bright confidence as before. Matter-of-fact joy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスーザン・ボイルの歌唱動画を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is watching a singing video of Susan Boyle.
lines.style: Observant, tender. She's tracking the pattern—beauty in unexpected places. Quiet recognition in her tone. Delivered with patient warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとアンディ・ガルシアの映画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched an Andy García movie together.
lines.style: Bright, satisfied report. He's settled into the rhythm of sharing with Dad. Quick and happy. A natural close to the exchange—contentment without fanfare.
